title: Mobile overlays: audit and fixes
description: Every menu, dialog, drawer, tray, bar, panel and toast that the mocked game produces was opened on three phone layouts (390x844, 360x740, 844x390 landscape) and measured in the page: the share of the map viewport it covers (elementFromPoint on a 12x12 grid, the map's own toolbar and legend not counted), whether a minimize or close control exists and what is left after using it, and which controls are under 44 px. Most overlays already minimize to a pill or bar. The ones that blocked the map or got in each other's way are fixed on phone layouts only (portrait up to 720 px wide, or up to 500 px tall); desktop is unchanged. The before shots are taken on the commit without the fixes and committed; the after shots and both audit tables are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BE (add TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the base commit for the before side). Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Audit before the fixes
shots.caption: Share of the map viewport covered by each overlay with it open, and after its minimize or close control is used. 844x390 reads 'map hidden by the page' because, without a minimize control for the action pane on a short screen, the pane and the toolbars leave no free map at all. The table does not show overlap between overlays, which the shots below do.

shots.heading: Audit after the fixes
shots.caption: Same measurement on the fixed build. The action pane can be minimized on landscape phones too, so the landscape column has a free map to measure. What still reads 'covers after minimizing' is a confirm bar that has to stay on screen (payment, prepare banner) plus the page's own header and toolbars.

shots.heading: Before: minimized decision pill, 390x844
shots.caption: The pill stretches from the middle of the screen to the right edge, cuts its label off and lies over the Players button.

shots.heading: After: minimized decision pill, 390x844
shots.caption: The pill spans the width above the Players / Events buttons, the label wraps and Resume decision is 44 px high. The map above stays tappable.

shots.heading: Before: minimized combat pill, 390x844
shots.caption: Same stretch and overlap for the space-combat pill; the system name is cut off.

shots.heading: After: minimized combat pill, 390x844
shots.caption: Full width above the buttons; the heading wraps instead of being cut off.

shots.heading: Before: minimized decision pill, 360x740
shots.caption: Overlaps the Players button at 360 px as well.

shots.heading: After: minimized decision pill, 360x740
shots.caption: Clear of the buttons.

shots.heading: Before: minimized combat pill, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: A 779 px wide pill that runs across the whole bottom edge.

shots.heading: After: minimized combat pill, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: A bottom-left pill at most 420 px wide, 44 px Resume button.

shots.heading: Before: prepare banner with the question minimized, 390x844
shots.caption: The 'Preparing' banner docks at the bottom, cannot be folded and lies over the Resume bar of the minimized stand-in question: the bar is hidden behind it (pill y=730, banner y=598 to 772).

shots.heading: After: prepare banner, open, 390x844
shots.caption: The Resume bar sits above the banner (the banner publishes its height), and the banner has a 44 px fold control.

shots.heading: After: prepare banner, folded, 390x844
shots.caption: Folded to its title, Save plan and the expand control: 58 px instead of 180 px. Resume decision brings the question back; the banner stays as it was left.

shots.heading: Before: prepare banner, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: The docked banner and the centred Resume bar overlap.

shots.heading: After: prepare banner folded, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: Resume bar bottom left, folded banner bottom right; neither covers the other.

shots.heading: Before: system panel, 390x844
shots.caption: Tapping a system during a decision opens a panel that covers 73% of the screen. Close was the only way to see the map again, and tapping another system was blocked by the panel.

shots.heading: After: system panel, open, 390x844
shots.caption: Same panel with a fold control (44 px) next to Close (now 44 px as well).

shots.heading: After: system panel, folded, 390x844
shots.caption: Folded to a bar with the system name at the bottom left, next to Players / Events. The map is tappable; tapping another system updates the title and keeps the bar folded.

shots.heading: After: system panel, folded, 360x740
shots.caption: Same at 360 px.

shots.heading: Before: card detail panel, 390x844
shots.caption: A strategy card from the player sheet opens the same panel over the map.

shots.heading: After: card detail panel, folded, 390x844
shots.caption: Folds the same way.

shots.heading: Before: error toast, 390x844
shots.caption: A refused history change leaves a red toast with no Dismiss over the Players / Events buttons until the next attempt.

shots.heading: After: error toast, 390x844
shots.caption: The toast floats above the buttons and has a 44 px Dismiss.

shots.heading: Before: undo confirmation, 390x844
shots.caption: Keep playing and Undo for everyone are 38 px high.

shots.heading: After: undo confirmation, 390x844
shots.caption: 44 px buttons.

shots.heading: Before: payment confirm bar, 360x740
shots.caption: With the payment list minimized the bar over the map is 220 px high (30% of the screen) with a hint line, a detail line and three rows of buttons.

shots.heading: After: payment confirm bar, 360x740
shots.caption: 191 px: the hint and the per-source line are dropped on phones, buttons are 44 px and share rows.

notesHeading: Left as it is, and why

notes.title: Decision dialogs (generic, combat, agenda, trade, production, reaction, objective scoring, strategy, remove-unit, tokens)
notes.text: Full-screen on a phone by design; every one has a minimize control that leaves a pill or the confirm bar. Not changed beyond the pill fix and 44 px minimize controls.

notes.title: Objectives and Technologies modals, undo confirmation
notes.text: Opened on purpose, closed with a 44 px Close / Keep playing; nothing on the map is needed while they are open.

notes.title: Players drawer and event log drawer
notes.text: Opened with the Players / Events buttons, which stay on top and close them with one tap. The map above them stays visible (they are at most 70% high). Not changed.

notes.title: Activation, planet selection and prepare chip
notes.text: Slim confirm bars (23% at most) that carry the Confirm button of the decision; they are the only way to continue, so they stay.

notes.title: Leadership planet-first payment, top chrome
notes.text: Covered by the parallel work on the payment panel (CommandTokenPanel, TokenPaymentBar) and on the header, status bar and menu sheet.

notes.title: Landscape
notes.text: The header, the map toolbar and the legend already leave little map on a 390 px high screen; the fixes here only make sure the overlays do not add to it. The top chrome is the other branch's job.
